stem:
Sonia's class decides who can be called healthy. Health means physical, mental, and social well-being, not only the absence of disease.

They compare three classmates:
1  Imran has no disease, but he feels anxious, sleeps poorly, and avoids group games.
2  Preeti is free from illness, eats balanced food, stays calm, and works well with friends.
3  Alok has strong arms and wins races, but he often feels angry and refuses to talk with classmates.

Who best meets the meaning of health?

options.text: Imran, because he has no disease.
Preeti, because physical, mental, and social well-being are all present.
Alok, because strong arms and race wins prove health by themselves.
Anyone with no cough this week, with nothing else checked.

teacher.key_rationale: Health needs physical, mental, and social well-being. Only Preeti shows all three. No disease or strong muscles alone are not enough.
